cause: R1386 already shows AVX32 format/detail gains but stable fixed-image x64 detail losses in the first Clang14 profile. The original R1385 change inserts a mode branch inside the existing vector core and changes its layout and GCC inlining. R1384 independently shows that a placement-only intervention can reproduce unaffected-architecture losses.
change: Put the mode decision at the existing vector call boundary in a new translation unit. Keep the original vector core byte-for-byte except its private entry name. For admitted 32-bit register-only VEX forms, reuse that core in wide mode and normalize rex/address-size metadata as the verified prototype does.
constraints: Do not assume relocation or speed equality from source structure
Keep LDS/LES, memory forms, register extensions and W1 on the canonical fallback
Preserve all old losses and measure the extra wrapper cost on legacy32 and 64-bit paths
No production padding or benchmark changes
